dct_title_s: India Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2022
dct_description_sm: # India Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Oct 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these flood proxy maps for India Floods (Oct 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: India, Floods, 16 Oct 2022, v0.5** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: India, Floods, 15 Oct 2022, v0.5** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: India, Floods, 15 Oct 2022, v0.5** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: India, Floods, 14 Oct 2022, v0.5** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022)
